full_prompt_en: A square finely hatched figurative painting shows four men clustered closely around a tabletop drawing in a warm, muted interior. The central man leans forward in a rose-pink shirt and dark olive tie, his dark hair combed back and his eyes lowered in concentration. One hand presses the pale paper flat, while the other guides a yellow pencil across faint linear marks. To his left, a gray-haired man in a light shirt bends in from the edge, watching the pencil tip and holding a small pale implement. Behind the central figure, another dark-haired man peers down over his shoulder, partly obscured by the close grouping. On the right, a reddish-haired man with a short beard bends toward the drawing in a dark green vest and white rolled-sleeve shirt. His hands hover near the table, one holding another slim drawing tool. Their heads create an inward-curving arch around the central work area, making the shared attention the scene's strongest gesture. The table fills the lower band with cream sheets, faint plans or sketch lines, transparent drinking glasses, and small amber liquid accents. The background is shallow and indistinct in mauve-gray and brown, so the group and their work occupy nearly all of the square. Fine colored hatching describes hair, cheeks, sleeves, and paper; blended pale faces remain legible amid the many short lines. Soft light from above-left falls most strongly on the central shirt, hands, and tabletop, while the outer shoulders and upper corners sit in deeper warm shadow. No clearly readable words appear on the papers. The overall composition concentrates four intersecting gazes and hands over a luminous horizontal surface, balancing intimate collaboration with precise, textured draftsmanship.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形细密排线人物画描绘四名男子在暖色低调的室内，紧紧聚在桌面图纸周围。中央男子穿玫瑰粉衬衣与深橄榄色领带，身体前倾，深发向后梳，眼睛专注地向下看。一只手压平浅色纸张，另一只手用黄色铅笔划过淡淡线形笔迹。左边，灰发男子穿浅色衬衣从边缘弯身凑来，看着笔尖，并拿着一件浅色细小工具。中央人物身后，另一位深发男子越过肩膀向下看，部分被紧密的人群遮住。右侧，一位红棕发、留短胡须的男子穿深绿背心与卷袖白衬衣，也朝图纸俯身。双手停在桌边，其中一只拿着另一支细长绘图工具。他们的头围成向内弯的拱形，把共同注意力变成场景最有力的动作。桌面填满下方色带，有奶油色纸张、淡淡规划或草图线、透明水杯和小片琥珀色液体强调。背景在灰紫与棕色中浅而模糊，让人群和工作几乎占满方画面。细密彩色排线描绘头发、双颊、衣袖与纸；晕染的浅色面容在许多短线间仍清楚可辨。柔和光从左上落来，最强地照亮中央衬衣、手和桌面，外围肩部与上方角落处于较深暖影中。纸上没有清楚可读文字。整体构图把四道交汇的视线与手集中在发亮的水平表面上，以亲密合作平衡精确、有肌理的素描手法。
style_prompt_en: The image has a colored-pencil and finely hatched painterly finish, with small directional lines building form across a restrained rose, cream, olive, mauve, and brown palette. Focal hands and pale planes are softly blended yet remain surrounded by visible linear texture. Outer forms overlap tightly and darken toward the frame, while a broad light lower surface provides a clear center of activity. Diffuse upper-side light brightens the middle without strong cast shadows, and warm-cool pencil marks articulate subtle volume. Repeated diagonal heads and arms converge on one low horizontal plane, creating a compressed, collaborative rhythm. The overall effect is intimate, diligent, and richly drawn.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有彩铅与细密排线结合的绘画完成面，细小定向线条在克制的玫瑰色、奶油色、橄榄色、灰紫和棕色调中建立形体。焦点处的手与浅色平面柔和晕染，却仍被可见线性肌理围绕。外围形体紧密交叠，向画框逐渐变暗，宽阔浅色下部表面提供清楚的活动中心。漫射上侧方光提亮中部，没有强烈投影，冷暖彩铅笔迹刻画细微体积。重复的斜向头部与手臂汇聚到一个低位水平面，产生压缩而合作的节奏。整体效果亲近、专注且素描肌理丰富。
theme_en: Four men leaning over a drawing spread across a table
theme_zh: 四名男子俯身研究桌上图纸
name: Paul Cadmus
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
